title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
abstract: arXiv:2611.08369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. tldr: NPCBench是一个模拟临床专科医师培训的鼻咽癌多模态诊疗路径推理基准，包含4,777个条目和100名患者的CarePath队列，通过回合级评估检验模型能否在完整诊疗路径中联合正确地完成诊断与诊疗任务。
en_tdlr: NPCBench is a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma that mirrors specialist training, containing 4,777 items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort, and uses episode-level evaluation to test whether models can jointly produce correct diagnostic and care answers within complete care pathways.
